name: Barbedlands
source:
Russian Brujah and Finn Toreador are given the task to take a van full of blood to Murmansk. It seems like this task will be a piece of cake. They agree to do it even if Baba Yaga gets in their way.

[From [url=https://the-cyberdog-we-deserve.itch.io/barbedlands]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
俄罗斯人布鲁亚和芬兰斗牛士接到任务，将一辆满载鲜血的货车开往摩尔曼斯克。看来这个任务将是小菜一碟。即使芭芭雅嘎妨碍他们，他们也同意这样做。

[来自[url=https://the-cyberdog-we-deserve.itch.io/barbedlands]Itch.io[/url]]
